description: Site detail, stats, publicUrl, brief head (default-on), and readiness flags. pages[] is a ~25-entry head by default (stats.pages has the true count); pass pages: true for the full array (capped at 1000), or list_content/get_site_manifest. Large sites (200+ pages): list_pages is paginated (cursor) or use get_site_manifest for the full route set.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site (pgg_…). Omit when signed in with OAuth.

pages.description: Return the full pages[] array instead of the default ~25-entry head (server-capped at 1000 either way). Default false.

name: get_site
